This initiative seeks to empower women and foster economic development across India. Discussions will inform the Financial Inclusion 2.0 agenda for better credit access.

banking-economy.title: Liquidity management, asset quality among pillars for NBFC growth: RBI DG
banking-economy.summary: RBI deputy governor Murmu highlighted five key areas for NBFCs and HFCs. These companies must focus on governance and liquidity management for sustainable growth. Asset quality and customer protection are also crucial for the sector's stability. Digital transformation and robust cybersecurity are essential for future operations. The regulator aims for proportional regulation and financial stability to support growth.
